7 انفتل , and ↓ تفتّل , [but the latter, as quasipass. of 2, denotes, or implies, muchness, or multiplicity,] It [a rope, &c.,] became twisted. (M, K.) ―
-b2- And the former, He turned away (T, S, Mgh) from his prayer, (T,) or from prayer, (Mgh,) or from his way, or course. (S.) And انفتل رَاجِعًا [He turned away, returning]. (S, O, K, in art. صوع.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
